cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key if you admit something that could get you grounded too. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. That's a weekend. This key is a month. Have you got anything bigger?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month each, then. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.

mechanism: A prices a family secret by punishment and offers a cheaper partial disclosure when B cannot yet meet the full price.
confusable: Unlike merely extracting a confession, A pays for each disclosure with an explicitly matched portion of A own secret.
comparison: Punishment-valued sibling secrets differ from workplace information and source access.
seedUse: D142-b key, mug, car and Jamie; S02-b changes the deal to preserve continued cooperation.
